ya: ya — O! (vocative particle, Arabic yā); also 'now, already' · also ya — 'would', reduced imperfect of aver as conditional ending, 3rd sg., after infinitive + clitic (pagar se ya 'would be satisfied'; = -ía)
es: seer — it is (present 3rd sg.) · also ser as perfect auxiliary of intransitives (exido es 'has gone out') and passive auxiliary (la tienda es cogida)
aguisado: guisar — fitting, reasonable (past part. used as adj.; variant of guisado)
fo: seer (and ir, which shares this preterite) — he/it was; went (preterite 3rd sg.; = fue, restored by Pidal as f[o]; of this part's three occurrences, fo entrado and fo acusado are periphrastic/passive ser + past part. constructions, while fo algo is a plain copula with a pronoun predicate, 'was something') · also commo fo tu voluntad, ca fo tu voluntad 'as/for it was your will' (ser + noun subject, 'it was'; Pidal restores f[o]) · also se fo acomendar 'went to commend himself' (ir); fo de noch 'it was night' (ser de + noun, 'night had come'); fo desenparada (passive, 'was abandoned')
minaya: Minaya — the title by which the Cid's kinsman Álvar Fáñez is called, usually explained as mi + anaya 'my brother'
e: e — and (= modern y) · also aver — I have (1st sg. present, apocopated form of he, perfect auxiliary: Espeso e el oro, 'I have spent the gold')
el: el — the (masc.) · also el — 'he who' before a relative (el qui quisiere, el que es sobre Fenares); el before a fem. noun beginning with a vowel (el espada = la espada; el algara = la algara)
campeador: Campeador — the Battler, the Champion (the Cid's epithet, from campo 'field of battle')
fincó: fincar — he planted, set firm (preterite; fincar los inojos 'to kneel')
y: y — and (rarer spelling of e) · also y — there (adverb, = i, Latin ibi; entraré y 'I shall enter there')
mesnada: mesnada — household troop, band of followers (= mesnada)
la: el/la — the (fem.); her/it (object pronoun) · also la que 'the one that' (Çelfa la que dizen de Canal 'Çelfa, the one they call of the Canal')
tierra: tierra — land, country; one's own land · earth (fezist çielo e tierra 'you made heaven and earth'; por tierra 'on earth')
angosta: angosto — narrow, scant, wretched (fem. sg., agreeing with tierra; tierra angosta 'a narrow, poor land'; = angosta, closest estrecha)
de: de — of, from · also de — by (the agent with a passive participle; = por) · also de — 'by (night)' (de noch), partitive 'of, among' (quinze moros … de los que alcançava; pocas de gentes), 'as' (de ganançia 'as booty'), 'from outside' (de fuera), 'on the right' (de diestro) · also 'about, concerning' (de mí non digan mal 'let them not speak ill of me') · also de — 'as if in' (commo de arrancada 'as if in rout'); 'in the manner of' (de guisa 'in such a way'); 'of, among' (de bivos pocos 'of the living few'); nominalized infinitive (del prender 'of the taking') · also de — 'with' of manner (de fuertes coraçones 'with stout hearts'); 'on' (de pie 'on foot'); 'from' of side (della e della part 'from both sides'); de cabo 'anew' (de + cabo, 'again'); de suso de 'above'; seños … de seños colpes 'with one blow each'
mala: malo — bad, evil (fem.; la mala cárçel 'the evil prison'; = mala)
los: el — the (masc. pl.); them (object pronoun) · also los que 'those who' (demonstrative use before a relative); los — him, them as object of consejar (commo los consejava 'as he advised them') · also los de 'those of' (con los de Castejón 'with the men of Castejón')
a: a — to, at · also aver — he/she has (3rd sg. present, h-less spelling of ha, as in el rey me a ayrado = el rey me ha airado) · personal a before a direct object (salvest a Jonás; a ti adoro); a + inf. 'to, about to' (tornólas a catar); a tan grand sabor 'with so great pleasure'; a ojo 'in plain sight' · also a — 'into' (sacar a çelada 'to lure into ambush'); 'at, in' (a la çaga 'at the rear'); 'against' (dar salto a la çaga); dative 'to' (a mí dedes); haber a + inf. 'have to' (lo han a far); a + noun of direction (adeliñava a la puerta 'made for the gate') · impersonal 'there is' (aver; es dia a de plazo 'there is (only) a day of the term', the most likely reading of a hard line); ha as auxiliary set after the participle (soñado a 'he has dreamt') · also 'on, at (a time)' (a tercer dia 'on the third day') · also a — 'has' before the participle, agreeing with the object (la lança a quebrada 'he has broken the lance'; a menester 'has need of'); a + dative of the person affected (a Minaya matáronle el cavallo 'they killed Minaya's horse')
mio: mio — my (unstressed possessive; mio Çid 'my lord Cid')
çid: Çid — the Cid, 'lord' (Arabic sīdī 'my lord'; pronounced Tsid)
moros: moro — Moor (masc. pl.); a moros nin a cristianos, 'to any living soul' (merism)
las: el/la — the (fem. pl.); them (fem. object pronoun)
yentes: yente — people, folk (= gente; y- from Latin g-)
fáriz: Fáriz — a Moorish 'king', commander with Galve of the army sent against the Çid; fictional, says Pidal (the name perhaps Arabic Fāris)
él: él — he (stressed subject pronoun) · also él — 'him, it' after a preposition, of a thing (a él vino; en él fincaredes 'in it', i.e. in Castejón)
entre: entre — between, among; entre X e Y 'X and Y together'
teca: Teca — Ateca, place in Zaragoza province (traditional identification)
terrer: Terrer — place name, a town near Calatayud (probably modern Terrer, Zaragoza province)
casa: casa — house; also settlement, town (Burgos la casa 'the town of Burgos')
que: que — that, who, which; for · also por que — because, since (= porque) · por que — by which, whereby (por que más valdrá 'whereby he will be worth more') · also que — 'so that, lest' introducing purpose/result (que por miedo non dexen nada; por tal lo faze … que no lo ventasse nadi); after después/mientra 'after, while' (después que, mientra que)
mas: mas — but · also mas — 'most' (superlative, = más; en todo lo mas alto 'on the very highest part')
ondrada: ondrar — honored, splendid (past part. fem. used as adj.; = honrada)
así: así — thus, so; así como 'as soon as'
lo: lo — him, it (object pronoun) · lo que perdedes 'that which you lose' (neuter antecedent of the relative) · also lo — neuter article 'what is' (lo to 'what is yours'); pleonastic 'it' (lo an, lo han a far; por tal lo faze 'for that reason he does it')
an: aver — they have (3rd pl. present of aver = han) · perfect auxiliary (passados los an 'they have passed'; la missa acabada la an 'they have finished'); an por troçir 'there remain to pass'; an ... ha far 'they have to do, are to do'
en: en — in, into, on · en — of it, thence (= ende; por en avemos qué fablar 'of which we have to speak') · also en — 'as' (en paria 'as tribute'); en essora 'at that moment'
carta: carta — letter, written decree · also 'written deed, charter' (escripta es la carta 'the charter (of peace) is written'; por carta 'in writing')
alcoçer: Alcoçer — Alcocer, a Moorish town the Cid camps before; site now unknown (Pidal: on the left of the Jalón, between Ateca and Calatayud)
por: por — through, along, by, for · purpose, 'in order to' (por el reyno quitar 'to quit the kingdom'); por + inf. 'yet to be done' (tres an por troçir 'three remain to pass'); 'for, on behalf of' (por mio Çid) · also por — 'out of, because of' (por miedo 'through fear'); 'for (that reason)' (por tal lo faze 'he does it for that reason'); 'by way of' (por Guadalfajara); por + noun 'for the sake of' ; por coraçón 'willingly' · also 'for (a price)' (por quanto serié conprada 'for how much it would be bought'); 'by means of' (por carta 'by writ'); 'through, thanks to' (por mí ganaredes 'through me you will gain') · also por — 'on, during (a time)' (por aquesta mañana 'this morning'); 'by way of, through' (por medio de la llaña 'through the middle of the plain')
marcos: marco — mark (a unit of weight for silver, pl.)
ruy: Ruy — Ruy, short form of Rodrigo (= Ruy)
ha: aver — he has (3rd sg. present; = ha) · ha — to (a with h-, aver a + inf. 'will, must': lo an todos ha far 'all are to do it'); aver — has, possesses (las fijas que ha 'the daughters she has') · also ha — future ending after infinitive + clitics, the split future (tornar nos la ha 'he will give it back to us'; = nos la tornará) · also ha — there is, there are (impersonal; dos señas ha cabdales 'there are two chief banners'; = hay)
qué: qué — what a …! (exclamative) · also qué — what? which? (interrogative pronoun/adjective, as in de qué será pagado, 'with what will he be satisfied') · indirect: que non sabe qué se far '(so that) she knows not what to do'; avemos qué fablar 'we have something to speak of'
bien: bien — well · bien — good, benefit (noun; algún bien vos pueda far 'some good I may do you') · bien — very, quite, intensifying an adverb (bien çerca del agua 'very near the water')
pago: pagar — I am content, satisfied (present 1st sg., reflexive me pago)
sos: so — his, her, their (= modern sus)
un: uno — a, one (apocopated masc. before a noun)
qui: qui — he who, whoever (old relative pronoun, Latin qui; = quien) · also qui — who? (interrogative; ¿qui los podrié contar? 'who could count them?'; = quién)
siempre: siempre — always, forever; por siempre 'for ever'
castiello: castiello — castle (= castillo; here the castle quarter of Burgos) · also the castle of Castejón (el castiello dexó en so poder)
quiso: querer — he wished (strong preterite 3rd sg.; non quiso 'he did not want'; = quiso)
quitar: quitar — to leave, quit (infinitive; el reyno quitar 'to quit the kingdom'; = quitar, closest abandonar) · also 'to set free' (quiero las i quitar 'I mean to free them there'; Pidal: 'libertar')
nos: nos — we (subject pronoun; = nosotros) · also nos — us, to us (object pronoun; atorgar nos hedes 'you will grant us') · also reflexive 'ourselves' (nos partimos 'we part'); dative (la missa nos dirá 'will say for us') · also nos' — non + se (aun nos' van del campo 'they are still not leaving the field'; the apostrophe marks the elision)
pagados: pagar — paid, satisfied (past part. masc. pl.; todos sodes pagados 'you are all satisfied'; = pagados)
part: part — share, portion (noun; = parte) · also part — side (del otra part 'on the other side'; = parte)
bivar: Bivar — Vivar, the Cid's home village just north of Burgos
seña: seña — banner, standard (= seña; modern seña is 'sign', the banner sense is enseña)
va: ir — he/she goes (present 3rd sg.; = va); ir + gerund, 'to be (gradually) doing' · ir + infinitive 'goes to' (la manol va besar 'goes to kiss his hand', el Duero va passar 'goes to cross the Duero') · also va — 'there is, goes on' impersonal (¡Qué priessa va en los moros! 'what a stir there is among the Moors!')
passó: passar — he passed, crossed (preterite 3rd sg.; = pasó)
salón: Salón — the river Jalón (the old form of the name; = Jalón)
ayuso: ayuso — down, downward (adverb, Latin deorsum; no modern equivalent, closest abajo)
al: a + el — to the; al menos 'even the least' · also a + el standing for a + la before a feminine noun beginning with a vowel (al espada = a la espada) · also al — 'other thing, the rest' (neuter, Latin alius; de lo al non pienssan nada 'of anything else they think nothing'; distinct from a + el)
exir: exir — to go out, leave (infinitive; = salir)
ovo: aver — he had (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = hubo; here perfect auxiliary, ovo bastidos = 'he had furnished') · ovo de + inf., little more than a plain past (las manos se ovo de untar 'his hands were smeared'); dont a ojo los ovo 'as soon as he had them in sight'
plogo: plazer — it pleased (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = plugo, modern plació)
más: más — more; e más 'and moreover' · non más 'no more, nothing more'; por que más valdrá 'whereby he will be worth more'
pesó: pesar — it grieved (preterite 3rd sg., impersonal; por cuer le pesó mal 'it grieved him sorely at heart'; = pesó)
ca: ca — for, because (Latin quia) · ca — perhaps 'but, whereas' (el uno es en paradiso, ca el otro non entró allá; the sense is uncertain)
pro: pro — worth, merit; de pro 'worthy, of good standing'
sobre: sobre — upon, over; here 'on the security of' (sobre aquellas arcas) · sobre Navas de Palos 'above, hard by Navas de Palos' (position along the route) · also 'before, against (a town to be besieged)' (sobre Alcoçer iva posar 'went to camp before Alcocer')
mont: Mont — mount, hill (Latin montem; = monte); Mont Mayor, the place Martín Muñoz held: Montemayor, a Portuguese town he governed for Alfonso VI, according to Pidal
sabet: saber — know, mark you (imperative 2nd pl., sabed; sabet = sabed; epic tag addressed to the audience)
metió: meter — he put (preterite 3rd sg.; metió mano 'laid hand to'; = metió)
paria: paria — tribute paid by a Muslim town for protection (sg.; en paria 'as tribute'; see parias)
enantes: enantes — before, sooner (adverb; enantes que 'before'; = antes)
desí: desí — from there, thence; thereupon (adverb, des + i 'there'; e desí arriba 'and from there upward'; = desde allí, después)
otra: otro — other (fem. sg.; del otra part 'on the other side', with el before a vowel-initial feminine noun, = de la otra parte)
delant: delant — ahead, in front (apocopated adverb; = delante)
mano: mano — hand (sg.); en vuestra mano = 'in your keeping'
tenié: tener — he had, was mounted on (imperfect 3rd sg., -ié ending; que tenié buen cavallo 'who had a good horse'; = tenía)
çelfa: Çelfa — Cella (Teruel), place on the road to Calatayud; Çelfa de Canal, see canal (= Cella)
canal: Canal — part of the name of Çelfa (Cella): Çelfa la que dizen de Canal 'Çelfa, the one they call of the Canal'; what Canal refers to is uncertain (Pidal does not explain it)
roy: Roy — Ruy, short for Rodrigo (Roy Díaz = Rodrigo Díaz, the Cid)
dios: Dios — God · also Dios! — interjection of wonder (Dios, cómmo se alabavan! 'God, how they boasted!')
aya: aver — I may have (present subjunctive 1st sg.; = haya)
álbar: Álbar — Álvar (personal name, Álbar Fáñez; = Álvar)
dio: dar — he gave, struck (preterite 3rd sg.; un colpe dio 'he struck a blow'; = dio) · dar a + inf. 'to give (something) to be …-ed' (Dio a partir estos dineros 'he had this money shared out')
si: si — if; si + subjunctive alone = 'if only …!' · si non — otherwise, if not (si non, do sopiéredes 'if not, wherever you learn'); si + future subjunctive 'if' (si nos falláredes 'if you find us')
vos: vos — you (object pronoun, polite/plural) · also subject 'you' (vos, que por mí dexades 'you who leave for my sake'); dative 'to you' (dar vos quiero vuestra part) · also reflexive/ethic 'you (yourselves)' (id vos en algara 'go off on a raid'); dative with an impersonal sense (si cueta vos fore 'if need befall you')
vala: valer — may he avail, protect (present subjunctive; vos vala 'may he keep you')
ora: hora — hour (= hora); en buen ora, part of the poem's honorific birth-formula, 'born in a good hour' · al ora 'at that very hour, then' (en ti crovo al ora)
cinxo: çeñir — he girded (strong preterite 3rd sg., Latin cinxit; en buen ora cinxo espada 'in a good hour he girded on the sword'; = ciñó)
quel: que + le — who ... him (que + enclitic/elided le) · that ... to him (quel creçe conpaña 'that company grows for him')
gañó: gañar — he won, captured (preterite 3rd sg.; = ganó)
valençia: Valençia — Valencia, the Moorish kingdom and city whose king Tamín is addressed (= Valencia)
dello: de + ello — of it, for it (de + neuter ello; = de ello)
mensaje: mensaje — message, messenger's errand (con mensaje 'with a message'; = mensaje)
çercar: çercar — to besiege, surround (infinitive; le van çercar 'they go to besiege him', ir + infinitive; = cercar)
campo: campo — field, open ground, field of battle (= campo; en el campo 'in the open field'; the element in Campeador) · campo de Taranz 'the plain of Taranz'
aquesta: aquesta — this (fem. sg., reinforced demonstrative; = esta, archaic aquesta)
batalla: batalla — battle (= batalla; exir a batalla 'to sally out to battle')
ganançia: ganançia — gain, profit, interest (= ganancia) · also booty, spoils of war (de ganançia 'as booty'; feremos grand ganançia 'we shall take great spoils')
presentaja: presentaja — gift, present (dar en presentaja 'to give as a gift'; Pidal: 'presente, regalo') · also an offer, a price proposed (d'aquesta presentaja 'with this offer'; Pidal: 'oferta o proposición de precio'); no modern form, closest presente, oferta
manos: mano — hand (pl.); dar las manos = the handclasp that makes an agreement binding
ayades: aver — you may have (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -des ending; = hayáis)
merçed: merçed — mercy, favor; Merçed! 'have mercy, I beg you' (= merced) · also merçed — grace, favour (con la merçed del Criador 'by the grace of the Creator')
dixo: dezir — he/she said (strong preterite; x = sh-sound; = dijo)
mañana: mañana — morning (a la mañana 'in the morning'; otro dia mañana 'next morning'; = mañana)
ayrado: ayrar — angered, placed in disgrace (past part.; = airado; el rey me a ayrado, 'the king has turned his wrath on me', the legal condition of ira)
cabo: cabo — beside, next to (preposition; cf. modern cabe) · also cabo — end (noun; fasta cabo del año, 'until the end of the year') · also de cabo — 'again, anew' (que los cometamos de cabo 'that we attack them again'; = de nuevo)
aun: aun — even, besides · also aun — yet, still (aun vea el dia 'may I yet see the day') · also 'even though' (= aunque; aun de lo que diessen oviessen grand ganançia, Pidal's reading)
me: me — me, to me · also reflexive 'myself' (fata que yo me pague 'until I am satisfied')
plaze: plazer — it pleases (present 3rd sg., impersonal; non plaze 'it does not please, they dislike it'; = place)
fizo: fazer — he made, did, caused (strong preterite 3rd sg.; fizo posar 'he made (them) halt'; = hizo)
tal: tal — such; por tal 'for such a reason, for this purpose' (= tal)
todo: todo — all, every (de todo conducho, 'with every kind of provision')
quito: quitar — I leave, give up (present 1st sg.)
id: ir — go! (2nd pl. imperative; id vos 'go (you)', with reflexive vos; = id, idos)
d: de — of, with (elided form of de before a vowel, d'arena = de arena) · de — from (unos d'otros 'one from another')
do: do — where, as (relative adverb, Latin de ubi; = donde) · also do — wherever, whenever (generalizing, with subjunctive: do yo vos enbiás 'wherever I might send you'; the exact sense is uncertain)
nada: nada — nothing; por nada 'for anything (in the world)'
far: far — to do (apocopated infinitive of fazer; = hacer)
grado: grado — thanks (grado a … 'thanks be to …') · also grado — will, good will (de grado 'willingly, gladly'; de grado non avrié nada, 'of good will there would be nothing to be had')
commo: commo — as, like (spelling variant of como) · how, that, in the way that (commo sirva a doña Ximena 'how he is to serve doña Ximena'); like (commo la uña de la carne) · also commo si + imperfect subjunctive — 'as if' (commo si escapasse 'as if he were fleeing')
fagades: fazer — you may make (present subjunctive 2nd pl.; = hagáis)
esso: esso — that (neuter demonstrative; esso con esto 'that together with this'; = eso)
sea: seer — may be, that is (present subjunctive 3rd sg.)
vagar: vagar — leisure, slowness (noun; de vagar 'at leisure, unhurriedly'; = vagar, closest despacio)
andar: andar — to travel, go on (infinitive; = andar)
dubda: dubda — doubt; also fear (sin dubda 'without fear', or 'without doubt, surely'; = duda)
buscar: buscar — to seek (infinitive; buscar nos verná 'he will come to seek us'; buscar nos ie 'he would seek us', infinitive + clitic + auxiliary, split future/conditional; = buscar)
